Redefining Data Privacy and AI

Duality is a fast-growing, well-funded startup on a mission to make the world’s most sensitive data usable without ever exposing it. We’re building the next generation of secure computation and privacy-preserving AI so governments, enterprises, and researchers can finally collaborate on data once thought untouchable.

If you’re passionate about deep tech and want real-world impact, join us.

  • See open positions

Work with the Pioneers of Privacy-Preserving AI

Duality isn’t just another data or AI company. We’re redefining how the world uses its most sensitive information. Our co-founders include a Turing Award winner, two MIT professors with encryption schemes named after them, a former RSA executive, a successful venture capitalist, and the co-creator of the PALISADE open-source homomorphic encryption library.

Around them we’ve built a team of subject matter experts who are widely recognized in their fields and passionate about shaping the future of Privacy Enhancing Technologies, AI governance, and secure collaboration.

Join Us

Duality believes that our employees are our best resource

Working at Duality means taking on challenges that no one has solved before. You’ll be part of a team that is inventing new ways to make untouchable data usable; securely, compliantly, and at scale. You’ll collaborate with cryptographers, engineers, data scientists, and business leaders who are all driven by the same vision: to unlock the full value of sensitive data without compromise. If you’re looking for a place where innovation meets purpose, where speed and impact are balanced with rigor and responsibility, Duality is the place to build your career.
